operations.summary: reco.calo.cell-cluster/1, a development binding: the cell chain (pedestal, then gain, each with its payload identity in chain order; raw kept beside calibrated) and t04-values-v4.md section 7.1 clustering of every event of a calo-cells/1 readout, written as calo-cluster-product/1 with sharing fractions per object; energy kind clustered deposited energy, never incident energy

inputs.name: cells
inputs.constraint: a calo-cells/1 file, role reconstruction-input, readout kind analog: raw values, live and saturated flags only; a dead cell has no value (NaN)

inputs.name: pedestal_payload
inputs.constraint: a calo-calibration-payload/1 file, role conditions, step pedestal, operation subtract, derived against no upstream payload

inputs.name: gain_payload
inputs.constraint: a calo-calibration-payload/1 file, role conditions, step gain, operation multiply or divide (its role in the chain), derived against the pedestal payload given

inputs.name: product
inputs.constraint: the calo-cluster-product/1 file to write; written only when the run finishes

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.constraint: a non-empty identity, recorded in the product header

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.constraint: a calo-cluster-configuration/1 file with exactly the written constants of t04-values-v4.md sections 4.2 and 7.1; default the t08-grid/1 configuration beside the script

failure_states.meaning: a component's sharing was undefined (a zero denominator); the product is written and records the failure. A component whose two-peak uncertainty is undefined keeps no object and is counted in uncertainty_failures with exit 0

an input is refused (missing, malformed, a readout kind other than analog, a role other than reconstruction-input, a payload bound on another upstream chain, a configuration key that is not version 4's); stdout carries status rejected (core/status.py) and the reason; no product is written
numpy or scipy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran

operations.summary: Read a calo-cluster-product/1 back, refusing a malformed or incomplete product, and check on every event that no cell is counted twice (the T08 sheet's stop)

failure_states.meaning: a cell is counted twice in at least one event; the first defects are listed

an input is refused (missing, malformed, a readout kind other than analog, a role other than reconstruction-input, a payload bound on another upstream chain, a configuration key that is not version 4's); stdout carries status rejected (core/status.py) and the reason; no product is written
numpy or scipy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran
